ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High dominance of high-intensity white pixels (estimated 85-90%) against low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels localized at margins and surface markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous field across both lobes. Dark pixel mapping is concentrated at the distal tips, along the lower trailing edge border, and a vertical concentration at the caudal peduncle insertion point.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees and significant pixel-depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary with high-frequency micro-peaks. Notable deep macro-notches are visible on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe and the outer margin of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edges sweeping to sharp, slightly upward-tilted distal tips; trailing edges exhibit a multi-wave concave-convex profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinctive circular high-contrast ring-shaped marking (dark outline with white center) located in the medial-lateral region of the right lobe. Smaller dark pixel clusters near the fluke base.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned dark linear tracks consistent with rake marks. Long diagonal tracks are visible on the upper-left lobe; shorter, near-vertical and horizontal tracks are distributed across the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch/missing tissue section on the trailing edge of the left lobe, positioned approximately 20% of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique closed-loop 'O' shaped pigment mark on the right lobe and a vertical dark pigment streak extending from the fluke base toward the notch.
